items.title: Madagascar : Michaël Randrianirina demande aux ministres de présenter leur stratégie anticorruption
items.description: Le president de la Refondation de Madagascar, le colonel Michael Randrianirina, a demande a l'ensemble des ministres de presenter publiquement leurs programmes et leurs strategies de lutte contre la corruption. Cette instruction a ete donnee lors du Conseil des ministres du 21 octobre, dans un contexte marque par une affaire de sortie illegale presumee de detenus etrangers. Selon cette directive, chaque ministre devra intervenir a la television nationale pour exposer les mesures envisagees contre la corruption ainsi que les principaux projets de son departement. Les citoyens devraient egalement pouvoir participer a ces emissions afin de poser des questions et soumettre des propositions. Cette initiative intervient alors que les autorites malgaches cherchent a etablir les responsabilites dans l'affaire de onze ressortissants chinois detenus pour des faits presumes d'escroquerie en ligne, qui auraient quitte illegalement leur prison. Selon la ministre malgache de la Justice, Fanirsoa Ernaivo, quatre de ces detenus ont deja quitte le pays, tandis que sept autres sont toujours recherches. Les circonstances de leur sortie restent a eclaircir. La ministre de la Justice et le syndicat des agents penitentiaires se rejettent mutuellement la responsabilite de l'incident. Les detenus auraient propose plusieurs milliards d'ariary, soit plusieurs centaines de milliers d'euros, pour obtenir leur sortie de prison. Dans le cadre de l'enquete, le directeur de l'etablissement penitentiaire a ete suspendu et quinze agents penitentiaires soupconnes de complicite ont ete places en garde a vue. La Chine s'est declaree prete a apporter son soutien aux investigations. Madagascar dispose deja d'une strategie nationale de lutte contre la corruption couvrant la periode 2025-2030. Toutefois, le pays a recule dans l'indice de perception de la corruption de Transparency International, se classant au 148e rang sur 182 pays en 2025, soit huit places de moins que l'annee precedente.

items.title: Fake business listings: How Ghanaians can check who they are paying
items.description: A customer searches for a business online, finds a phone number, discusses a booking and sends a deposit. Later, the business says it never received the money. The person who answered the call was pretending to work there. Ghana’s Cyber Security Authority (CSA) has warned that fraudsters are placing fake business listings on search engines and online maps. In an alert issued in April, it said 54 such cases had been reported between January 1 and April 26, 2026, with losses totalling GH₵266,195. Cybersecurity governance and risk specialist Valerie Arko-Adjei says customers should verify who they are dealing with before sending money. Finding a business online, she explains, does not mean the contact number beside its name belongs to it. The scam works because the first steps feel ordinary. Many people use a search result or a map listing to find a phone number without giving it much thought. A fraudster can use the name and address of a real business, then substitute a number they control. Once a customer gets in touch, the conversation may sound much like a genuine booking or sale. Knowing the price of a service does not prove that the person answering is legitimate. Prices, photographs and descriptions may already be public. Before agreeing to pay, customers should check whether the number they called appears on the business’s own website or on a social media account they know belongs to it. If the details do not match, they should contact the business through a different, independently verified channel. Arko-Adjei also urges customers to pay attention to sudden changes in payment instructions. Someone might say the usual mobile money number is temporarily unavailable or ask for a deposit to be sent to a personal account. There may be innocent reasons for a change, but customers should confirm it with the business using contact details they found separately. Calling the number that sent the new instructions only takes them back to the person whose identity they are trying to establish. The CSA says some people responding to fake listings have been directed to forms asking for their phone number, mobile network, transaction amount, and mobile money PIN. A request for a PIN, one-time code, or banking password should end the conversation. Customers should leave the form or chat and contact their payment provider or the business through a number they have verified themselves. If a payment has already been made, acting quickly matters. Contact the payment provider, explain what happened, and ask what steps are available for that transaction. Keep screenshots of the listing and conversation, along with the phone number and payment reference. Anyone who shared a PIN or code should secure the affected account immediately and report the incident. These records may help the provider and authorities investigate. Arko-Adjei says businesses must make it easier for customers to check they are dealing with the right people. Those that accept online bookings or deposits can make their official contact numbers and payment channels easy to find. A clear notice explaining how payments are requested, and stating that staff will never ask for a customer’s mobile money PIN or one-time code, gives people something to check against when a message feels wrong. Business owners should also search for their own names and check the phone numbers shown in map results. If they find an impersonator, they can report the listing to the platform and warn customers using their genuine accounts. Staff should know how to handle a report from someone who may have paid a fake account, including gathering the listing details and directing the customer to their payment provider. The warning comes ahead of Ghana’s National Cyber Security Awareness Month in October. At the campaign’s September launch, the CSA said it had recorded 3,876 cybersecurity incidents between January and July 2026, with online fraud making up about 47%. That figure covers online fraud generally; it is not a count of fake business listings. Arko-Adjei says the answer is to pause when a search result turns into a request for money: check the contact number, confirm any change in payment details, and keep PINs and security codes private. A short check before paying could spare a customer a far more difficult conversation afterwards. Suspicious listings and cybercrime incidents in Ghana can be reported to the CSA by calling or texting 292, sending a WhatsApp message to 050 160 3111, or emailing report@csa.gov.gh . Valerie Arko-Adjei is a cybersecurity GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Professional with a background in behavioural science, focused on helping businesses and individuals understand risk and build stronger security habits through human-centred cybersecurity. She can be reached via adjeiv2@yahoo.com .

items.title: DPM Dar meets Turkish FM ahead of R-4 bloc, European diplomats’ meetings
items.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar on Friday met with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, ahead of a meeting of R-4 foreign ministers and a meeting between the R-4 and European diplomats, the Foreign Office (FO) said. The R-4 group, comprising Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye, emerged in March and has been focusing on regional security and mediation efforts between the United States and Iran. In a post on X, the FO said that Dar thanked Fidan for hosting the meetings and that the pair discussed bilateral relations and regional developments, particularly the situation in the Middle East and Palestine. “They expressed concern over threats to regional stability and underscored the importance of dialogue, diplomacy and coordinated efforts to promote regional peace and security,” the FO post said. Additionally, Dar and Fidan strongly condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed their commitment to close coordination on regional issues, including under the Makkah Defence Agreement. “Both leaders reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the longstanding bonds of friendship and brotherhood between Pakistan and Turkiye, and to deepening cooperation across all areas of mutual interest, both bilaterally and in multilateral fora,” the FO added. Dar left for Istanbul earlier in the day and is attending the meeting at the invitation of Fidan. In a post on X, the FO said that upon his arrival, Dar arrived in Istanbul and was received by Director General of the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs Cihad Erginay and Pakistan’s Chargé d’Affaires Shaiq Ahmed. The FO added that during his one-day visit, Deputy Prime Minister (DPM) Dar would participate in the R-4 and R-4-plus meetings with France, Germany, Italy and the United Kingdom. Dar would also call on Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and hold bilateral meetings with his counterparts, the FO said. Earlier, FO said that the ministers will participate in a meeting with counterparts from the European E-3 bloc — UK, France, and Germany — following the R-4 meeting. The E-3 group comprises three European powers that established the grouping more than 20 years ago to advance diplomatic coordination on Iran’s nuclear programme. Italy will also be a part of the meeting, FO had added. “This will be the first meeting of the seven countries in this format,” FO said. “The meetings will focus on key regional developments and explore coordinated diplomatic approaches to address shared challenges and advance regional peace and stability,” FO added. DPM Dar is also set to hold bilateral meetings with his counterparts during his visit as well. “Pakistan’s participation reflects its continued commitment to constructive diplomacy, regional cooperation and the peaceful resolution of disputes,” FO said. Talks to revolve around Hormuz, Saudi Arabia British foreign minister Ed Miliband’s office said the talks would essentially revolve around “the Strait of Hormuz and the situation in Saudi Arabia”. It said Miliband “will advocate for a diplomatic solution to the (Hormuz) crisis that restores full navigational rights and freedoms”. He will also stress “how Iranian tactics are being replicated across the region, with attacks on Saudi Arabia further destabilising the region and increasing pressure on vital waterways and global chokepoints, such as Bab El-Mandeb and the Suez Canal”, it added. France confirmed the talks on “the Iranian crisis in its various ramifications”, hailing it as a first “in this format… against a backdrop of extreme instability and uncertainty in the region.” The meeting will aim to “strengthen coordination between Europeans and Middle Eastern countries in the face of crises that we did not choose and that affect us all,” the French foreign ministry said. A Turkish diplomatic source also told Reuters a day earlier that the seven countries would meet in the R-4+E-3 format for the first time at Turkiye’s initiative as wars involving Iran , Yemen and Ukraine threaten shipping routes and regional security. Fidan is expected to emphasise the need for a diplomatic solution to the war between the United States and Iran, the importance of freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb, and reiterate Turkiye’s support for Saudi Arabia’s security against attacks by Yemen’s Houthi rebels under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement signed by Islamabad, Ankara, and Riyadh, the sources said. The Makkah defence pact , signed on Aug 7, aims to strengthen collective deterrence and empower its signatory states to treat an attack against one of them as an attack against all of them.

items.title: Última hora de la actualidad política, en directo | Pedro Sánchez responde a Feijóo: “Criarse entre mujeres no te hace feminista. Defender sus derechos, sí”
items.description: El líder del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, ha asegurado en una entrevista en Cadena SER que es feminista porque “se ha criado en una casa con más mujeres que hombres”. El presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, le ha contestado con un mensaje en X: “Feijóo es tan feminista que propone cargarse el Ministerio de Igualdad y recortar el derecho de las mujeres a decidir sobre su propio cuerpo. Criarse entre mujeres no te hace feminista. Defender sus derechos, sí”. También el ministro para la Transformación Digital, Óscar López, ha respondido a las declaraciones del líder popular, en este caso sobre el salario mínimo, que los populares proponen negociar con la patronal. “En este país, en los últimos ocho años se ha subido ocho veces el salario mínimo; de las ocho, solo una ha contado con el apoyo de la patronal, es decir, si lo dejáramos en la mano de la patronal, no subiría el salario mínimo”, ha recordado López. El líder popular también ha asegurado en Cadena SER que su objetivo es echar a Pedro Sánchez del Gobierno porque le considera “un personaje tóxico y conflictivo”. Feijóo ha añadido que intentará gobernar aunque el PP no sea la lista más votada y ha confirmado que, si lo necesita, pactará el Gobierno con Vox, como ha hecho en varias comunidades autónomas. items.title: Kanayo, Kate Henshaw, others mourn late actor Francis Duru
items.description: Some Nigerian actors have expressed grief over the death of veteran Nollywood actor Francis Duru, describing him as a talented performer whose contributions to the film industry would be remembered. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Duru died on Friday at the age of 57 following a brief illness. His passing comes just two years after the tragic loss of his 15-year-old son, Ifeanyi, leaving fans and the film industry in deep mourning. Actor Kanayo O. Kanayo, in a tribute shared on his Instagram page, described Duru as a consummate actor and one of Nigeria’s most versatile and prolific performers. “A consummate actor has left the stage. One of the most flexible, prolific performers Nigeria ever produced. Rest in peace, my brother,” Kanayo wrote. Actress Kate Henshaw also mourned Duru, reflecting on the brevity of life and praying for the repose of his soul. “Like a flame gone out, so are our lives when it all ends,” she wrote, adding a prayer for God to grant Duru eternal rest and comfort his loved ones. Similarly, actress Mercy Johnson-Okojie expressed her grief, saying she was too overwhelmed by the loss to find the words to describe her feelings. “Too tired and speechless about this loss,” she wrote. Actress Stephanie Linus described Duru’s death as tragic and heartbreaking, praying for strength for his family to bear the loss. “Such a tragic and heartbreaking loss. May God grant his family the strength and fortitude to bear this loss. May his soul rest in peace. RIP Francis Duru,” she wrote. The tributes reflect the grief of Duru’s colleagues over the loss of a fellow actor whose performances endeared him to audiences. Duru rose to fame for his role as Ahanna in Amaka Igwe’s classic film Rattlesnake, building a career that spanned more than three decades in the Nigerian film industry. The actor’s family announced his death in a statement on his official Instagram page in the early hours of Oct. 23, 2026. (NAN) The post Kanayo, Kate Henshaw, others mourn late actor Francis Duru appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: ‎Tenkodogo : Les agents des eaux et forêts capturent un crocodile près d'un poulailler et le relâchent dans le barrage
items.description: ‎Un crocodile qui rôdait près d'un poulailler dans une cour du quartier Gommisi, en face du Groupement de gendarmerie de Tenkodogo, a été capturé sans incident le jeudi 22 octobre 2026, puis relâché dans le barrage de la ville. ‎Selon l'agence d'information du Burkina qui rapporte l'information, c'est un habitant qui a donné l'alerte aux services compétents après avoir aperçu le reptile dans la concession. Les agents du Service départemental des Eaux et Forêts (SDEF) de Tenkodogo, appuyés par la Brigade des Eaux et Forêts du Nakambé, se sont aussitôt rendus sur les lieux. ‎ ‎Selon la Direction régionale des Eaux et Forêts du Nakambé, l'animal a été maîtrisé dans le respect des mesures de sécurité, puis relâché dans le barrage de Tenkodogo. Aucun dégât n'a été constaté. Cette intervention souligne l'importance de la vigilance citoyenne à proximité des points d'eau. Les Eaux et Forêts rappellent qu'il ne faut pas s'approcher ni tenter de capturer un animal sauvage, mais signaler immédiatement sa présence aux services compétents. ‎ ‎Lefaso.net ‎Source : Agence d'Information du Burkina

items.title: Liban : le tandem Hezbollah-Amal se fissure autour de la guerre et du rôle de l’État
items.description: Le tandem chiite libanais montre des signes de plus en plus visibles de tension. Le 22 octobre, le president du Parlement et chef du mouvement Amal, Nabih Berri, a reconnu que sa relation avec le Hezbollah etait « plus etroite » a l'epoque de Hassan Nasrallah. Une declaration inhabituelle pour celui qui s'est longtemps efforce d'afficher l'unite avec son principal allie. Les divergences portent d'abord sur la strategie regionale du Hezbollah. Depuis son engagement dans la guerre aux cotes de l'Iran en mars, Amal redoute que le Liban-Sud ne soit entraîne dans une nouvelle escalade dont la communaute chiite paierait directement le prix. Berri reproche notamment au Hezbollah de prendre certaines decisions militaires et regionales sans l'associer suffisamment. Des affrontements ont eu lieu entre les partisans des deux camps Le desaccord est egalement politique. Contrairement au Hezbollah, Amal adopte une attitude plus pragmatique envers le gouvernement de Nawaf Salam, refuse de provoquer sa chute et se montre davantage dispose a soutenir le principe d'un monopole des armes par l'etat. Berri privilegie aussi les negociations indirectes avec Israel et le rapprochement avec l'Arabie saoudite, tout en restant critique vis-a-vis du cadre actuel des discussions. Ces tensions commencent aussi a apparaître sur le terrain. Plusieurs affrontements entre militants ou sympathisants des deux formations ont ete signales ces dernieres semaines dans des villages du Liban-Sud, parfois avec des echanges de tirs. Les directions d'Amal et du Hezbollah interviennent systematiquement pour eviter que ces incidents ne degenerent. Il ne s'agit toutefois pas encore d'une rupture. Berri continue de servir d'intermediaire entre le Hezbollah, l'etat libanais et plusieurs acteurs etrangers. Mais le rapport de force change : Amal cherche davantage a proteger les interets libanais et chiites face a une nouvelle guerre regionale, tandis que le Hezbollah reste lie a la strategie iranienne.

items.title: When the economy decides what is on your plate
items.description: By Josephine Agbonkhese THERE was a time when eating healthily was a conversation many Nigerians could relate to. Parents worried about balanced meals, children were encouraged to eat their vegetables, and eggs, milk, fish and fruits were familiar items on many household shopping lists. Today, for many families, eating healthily is becoming less of a lifestyle choice and more of a financial privilege, as the rising cost of food forces households to rethink what they eat. Read Also: Why food prices remain high despite FG’s interventions, ongoing harvest As food prices continue to soar, putting a balanced meal on the table has become a daily struggle for many households, with eggs, milk, fish, meat, chicken, vegetables and even fruits now competing with rent, transport fares, school fees and other household expenses. According to the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), the average daily cost of a healthy diet for one adult rose from ₦858 in January 2024 to ₦1,451 in November 2024, reaching approximately ₦1,589 by April 2026. These figures exclude transportation and cooking costs, including cooking gas, which further increase the cost of preparing meals. For families already struggling to make ends meet, the consequences can be serious. UNICEF’s 2026 mid-year report rated Nigeria as having the second-highest burden of childhood stunting globally, highlighting the difficulties many families face in providing nutritious meals. While the government may point to improvements in economic indicators, many Nigerians are still asking a simpler question: why does the money in their pockets buy so little food? But with nutritious meals becoming increasingly expensive, how can households eat better without spending beyond their means? Add Colour to Your Plate Eating healthily does not necessarily mean buying expensive imported vegetables or fruits. Sometimes, it begins with adding a little colour to the food you already eat. Ugu, waterleaf, okra, carrots and cabbage can provide essential vitamins and minerals. Rather than buying several varieties at once, choose one or two affordable vegetables and include them in soups, stews, yam dishes or rice. Seasonal produce is often a more economical choice. Buying from local markets, comparing prices among sellers and purchasing only what your family can consume before it spoils can also help. The goal is to make vegetables a regular part of meals, even when portions are small. Incorporate More Legumes Beans deserve a more prominent place in every kitchen right now because they are a valuable source of protein, fibre and other nutrients. They can also help reduce dependence on more expensive animal protein sources. Think bean porridge, moi-moi and akara. Think beans served with rice, yam or plantain. Groundnuts can serve as an affordable snack, while cowpeas and other locally available legumes offer variety. For households that find it difficult to afford beans in large quantities, buying smaller amounts regularly may be more manageable. Preparing a pot that provides more than one meal can also save Prioritise at Least One Intentional Meal Daily When money is scarce, trying to make every meal perfectly balanced can feel overwhelming. Start with one meal a day that deliberately combines different food groups. For breakfast, pap could be paired with moi-moi or akara. Rice could be served with beans and vegetables, while yam could accompany an egg-and-vegetable sauce when affordable. The idea is to look beyond simply filling the stomach. Carbohydrates provide energy, while protein-rich foods and vegetables supply other nutrients the body needs. When eggs, fish or meat are too expensive, beans and other affordable protein sources can help bridge the gap. One intentional meal a day is, however, only a starting point, not a substitute for a nutritious diet throughout the day. Choose Seasonal and Locally Available Foods Healthy eating does not have to revolve around expensive cereals, imported fruits or packaged beverages. Nigerian staples such as sweet potatoes, maize, millet and cassava, alongside locally grown fruits, can contribute to a varied diet. The trick is to buy what is in season, available locally and reasonably priced. A family can alternate between rice, beans, yam, potatoes and other staples rather than relying on one food item for every meal. It also helps to plan meals around current market prices instead of deciding on a menu only to discover that the ingredients are unaffordable. Plan, Prepare and Preserve A little planning can make a difference. Before going to the market, check what is already in the kitchen, prepare a simple weekly menu and make a shopping list. Compare prices and avoid buying perishable foods in quantities your family cannot consume before they spoil. Cooking beans, soups or stews in batches can reduce repeated spending on cooking gas, provided the food is cooled, stored safely and reheated properly. Leftovers should be refrigerated promptly where possible, while dry staples should be kept in clean, airtight containers. items.title: Kaduna rally: ‘Your posters enjoy protection Nigerians can only dream of’ — Atiku tackles Tinubu
items.description: By Ayobami Okerinde Atiku Abubakar, former vice-president and presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), has criticised President Bola Tinubu over reports that security operatives are guarding his campaign billboards in Kaduna State ahead of Saturday’s All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign launch. In a post on X on Friday, Atiku questioned why Tinubu’s campaign posters were seen protected while Nigerians continued to face attacks by bandits and terrorists. “Bola, you claim Nigerians love you, yet your billboards in Kaduna require security guards. Bandits raid villages, terrorists attack communities, and families live in fear. Your posters enjoy protection that millions of Nigerians can only dream of,” he wrote. “What a tragic statement of your government’s priorities. Bola, please protect Nigerians with the same urgency you protect your image!” he added. Tinubu is expected to attend the inaugural APC presidential campaign rally in Kaduna on Saturday, October 24, alongside other top government officials. Ahead of the visit, the Kaduna State Police Command announced restrictions on trailers, tankers, lorries and other heavy-duty vehicles in Kaduna metropolis from midnight until 8pm on Saturday. The Commissioner of Police, Muhammad Rabiu, said the restriction followed consultations between the state security committee and transport unions and was intended to ease traffic congestion and ensure smooth movement during the presidential visit. Rabiu said the police, military, Department of State Services and other security agencies had put security arrangements in place, including the deployment of tactical teams, explosive ordnance disposal units, traffic officers and crowd-control personnel. He also warned political parties and their supporters against thuggery, violence, intimidation and the possession of dangerous weapons, urging residents to cooperate with security agencies to ensure a peaceful campaign rally. items.title: Forms Capital wins CIMG Marketing-Oriented Finance House of the Year, 2025
items.description: Forms Capital Limited has been adjudged Marketing-Oriented Finance House of the Year, 2025 at the Chartered Institute of Marketing, Ghana (CIMG) 37th Annual National Marketing Performance Awards, in recognition of the company’s excellence in strategic marketing and its commitment to creating value for customers and delivering strong business results. The award was presented at the ceremony on Saturday, 17 October 2026, at the Labadi Beach Hotel in Accra. The recognition highlights Forms Capital’s strategic approach to marketing, including the use of market insights, effective marketing programmes and customer-focused initiatives to support business growth and strengthen its position in Ghana’s financial services industry. For Forms Capital, the recognition represents an important milestone in its commitment to making financial services more accessible, relevant and impactful for individuals, businesses and communities. Commenting on the achievement, Ishmael Abbey, Head of Business Development at Forms Capital Limited, said: “ We are honoured to receive this recognition from the Chartered Institute of Marketing, Ghana. It affirms our belief that marketing goes beyond promoting products and services; it is about understanding people’s needs, creating meaningful value and building lasting relationships with customers”. “At Forms Capital, we continue to pursue innovative and customer-focused approaches that connect our financial solutions to the aspirations of individuals, entrepreneurs and businesses. This award is an encouragement to keep challenging ourselves, deepening customer trust and contributing to the growth of the communities we serve. We are grateful to our customers, partners and dedicated team members whose continued support and commitment make achievements like this possible”, he added. Advancing Customer-Centred Financial Services Forms Capital Limited continues to strengthen its approach to financial services through customer-focused solutions, strategic partnerships and initiatives designed to respond to evolving financial needs. Its marketing philosophy centres on connecting customers with relevant financial opportunities while building trust, improving engagement and supporting sustainable business growth. As the company advances its growth ambitions and prepares for its next phase of development in Ghana’s financial services sector, the CIMG award provides further motivation to deepen its commitment to innovation, customer experience and responsible business growth. The company recognises that sustainable success is built on a combination of strong strategy, customer understanding, effective execution and the collective efforts of its people. This achievement therefore belongs to the entire Forms Capital team, alongside the customers and partners who continue to be part of its journey.

items.title: 10 India-sponsored terrorists killed as bid to undermine state's writ in Gwadar foiled: ISPR
items.description: Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Friday that 10 India-sponsored terrorists were killed in separate engagements as security forces thwarted their attempts to “undermine the writ of the state” in Balochistan’s Gwadar district. In a statement, the military’s media affairs wing said: “On Oct 22, Indian-sponsored terrorists of Fitna al Hindustan attempted to carry out terrorist activities in district Gwadar, in the general areas of the Gabd Border Crossing and Gwadar city.” The state has designated Balochistan-based groups as Fitna al Hindustan to highlight India’s role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan. “By targeting these locations, terrorists sought to harm the very people they claim to represent and wanted to obstruct the development and prosperity of Balochistan. To protect residents and clear the area, security forces launched clearance operations in and around Gwadar city,” ISPR said. It said that in separate engagements, security forces foiled the terrorists’ designs and “their bid to undermine the writ of the state and spread their misconstrued agenda”. “In the ensuing exchanges of fire, ten terrorists, including one female terrorist, were sent to hell. During the terrorist attacks one civilian embraced shahadat (martyrdom) and [a] few vehicles were damaged. Operations were concluded without any loss to security forces, restoring order and writ of the state,” it said. The statement further said that the coercion of a Baloch woman into the attack was “a crime not only against the state but against the hurmat (respect) of Baloch women”. “It exposes the terrorists’ cynical exploitation of Baloch women as an instrument of propaganda, intended to inflame public sentiment and lend false sanctity to their campaign. Such tactics are contrary to Baloch and Islamic traditions, which hold women in the highest honour. The people of Balochistan have consistently rejected those who shed blood in their name, and they will see through this deception as well,” it said. The statement said that the counterterror campaign would continue at full pace. “Security forces and law enforcement agencies remain resolute in eliminating foreign-sponsored and supported terrorism from the country,” it said. The ISPR statement comes a day after security sources said that security forces killed three terrorists and foiled an attack on an unoccupied construction company camp in Gwadar. Balochistan has witnessed an increase in terrorist activities in recent years, prompting security forces to intensify counter-terrorism operations. Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir said earlier on Friday the armed forces will continue the counterterrorism campaign against Indian-sponsored terrorist groups “to the fullest”, vowing to “hit them hard wherever they are”. Earlier this week, ISPR said an army major was martyred and four terrorists were killed during intelligence-based operations in Balochistan. The number of terrorist attacks in the province increased by seven per cent from 83 in July to 89 in August , according to data compiled by the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies (PICSS). As per the report, Balochistan was declared the province “most affected” by terrorism. Following the latest operations by security forces in Gwadar, President Asif Ali Zardari commended the security forces for foiling the terrorists’ attempts. “The president also expressed deep sorrow and grief over the martyrdom of a citizen in a terrorism incident,” the statement issued by the Presidency said. It further quoted President Zardari as saying that efforts to disrupt peace and stability in Balochistan could not shake the people’s resolve for development and prosperity in the province. He stressed the importance of peace for the protection of the rights and interests of people of Balochistan and said that “using the honour of Baloch women for political interests is condemnable”.

items.title: At least 12 killed, 22 injured in road accident near Zero Point in Balochistan’s Uthal
items.description: KHUZDAR: At least 12 passengers were killed and around two dozen injured when a minibus and a passenger coach collided head-on near Zero Point in Uthal on the Quetta-Karachi Highway in Balochistan on Friday, police said. Police officials said the coach was travelling from Gwadar to Karachi, while the minibus was heading to Karachi from Bela. “The tragic incident took place near Bela when the passenger coach hit the minibus,” the officials said, adding that seven passengers were killed on the spot, while five others succumbed to their injuries in hospital. In-charge of the Edhi Centre in Bela Abdul Hakeem Lasi, said around 22 injured passengers were shifted to hospital by Edhi workers before being moved to Karachi for treatment. He said the condition of seven injured passengers was serious. Most of the casualties occurred in the minibus, he added. The accident occurred two days after 10 people were killed and 44 others injured when a passenger bus overturned after hitting a road divider in Rajanpur district’s Rojhan tehsil on the Indus Highway on Wednesday, according to Rescue 1122. A similar accident occurred last month when two people were killed and 15 others injured in a head-on collision between a passenger coach and an LPG bowser near Balochistan’s Kharkhera Customs on the main National Highway in Winder. In February, five people, including a local journalist, were killed in two separate road accidents in Winder and Khuzdar districts. In January, four people were killed and several others injured in a road accident near Wadh in Khuzdar district on the Quetta-Karachi National Highway.

items.title: REMA 2026 : La musique burkinabè, porte-voix de la cohésion sociale
items.description: Lancée officiellement le mercredi 21 octobre, la 9e édition des Rencontres musicales africaines (REMA) a mis la musique burkinabè à l'honneur lors de la soirée du jeudi 22 octobre 2026. À la Cité de la musique, cinq artistes nationaux ont fait vibrer le public à travers le showcase « Musique Burkina ». Ils ont ainsi mis en lumière leurs talents et porté des messages de paix. Au cours de cette soirée, cinq artistes burkinabè se sont succédé sur scène pour partager leur univers musical avec le public, dans une ambiance électrique. Élue 111, Eunice Goula, Damo Fama, Fereke Wassa et Moussa Dabré ont tenu le public en haleine à travers ce showcase consacré à la richesse et à la diversité de la création musicale nationale. L'Elue 111 en prestation Par leurs prestations, ces artistes ont contribué à valoriser la musique burkinabè et à promouvoir les talents locaux. Ils s'inscrivaient ainsi dans le cadre de ce rendez-vous consacré aux professionnels et aux acteurs de l'industrie musicale africaine. Au-delà du divertissement, le showcase « Musique Burkina » a également été l'occasion de porter des messages de paix. Dans un contexte où la cohésion sociale demeure un enjeu majeur, la musique s'affirme comme un moyen d'expression et de sensibilisation capable de rassembler les populations autour de valeurs communes. Cette initiative s'inscrit dans la dynamique des REMA, qui offrent un cadre de rencontre, de partage et de promotion aux artistes et aux professionnels de la musique du continent. En mettant ainsi la création burkinabè à l'honneur, cette soirée a rappelé le rôle de la culture et de la musique dans la promotion du vivre-ensemble et de la paix. Eunice Goula en prestation La 9e édition des REMA se poursuit avec l'ambition de contribuer à la réflexion sur l'avenir de l'industrie musicale africaine et sur les opportunités qu'elle offre aux artistes du continent. items.title: Conakry : le procureur général ordonne le démantèlement des lieux criminogènes
items.description: Le procureur général près la Cour d’appel de Conakry, Fallou Doumbouya, a requis le concours des forces de sécurité pour identifier et démanteler les lieux servant à la préparation, à la commission ou à la dissimulation d’infractions dans la capitale. Dans une réquisition aux fins de concours de la force publique publiée à cet effet, il a instruit le commandant de la Gendarmerie spéciale de la ville de Conakry et le directeur régional de la Police de Conakry de procéder sans délai aux opérations nécessaires, en coordination avec les procureurs de la République compétents. Les opérations visent notamment les zones et abris criminogènes, les bâtiments, terrains et chantiers délaissés, utilisés à des fins délictueuses, les lieux de recel ainsi que les points de trafic, de vente ou de consommation illicites de stupéfiants et de substances psychotropes. Pour faciliter la localisation de ces sites, les forces de sécurité devront également solliciter l’appui de l’administration territoriale, notamment des conseils communaux et de leurs démembrements. La réquisition prévoit par ailleurs de faire cesser les infractions constatées, de démanteler les dispositifs affectés aux activités illicites et de procéder au déguerpissement des lieux concernés. Les personnes contre lesquelles existent des éléments individualisés de participation aux faits, en qualité d’auteur, de coauteur ou de complice, devront être identifiées. Leur interpellation et leur déferrement devant le procureur de la République compétent pourront intervenir, lorsque les conditions légales seront réunies. Le procureur général exige enfin que ces opérations soient menées avec un recours à la force strictement nécessaire et proportionnée. Les autorités concernées sont également tenues de lui rendre compte des diligences accomplies. La réquisition s’appuie sur l’article 41 de la loi L/2016/060/AN du 26 octobre 2016 portant Code de procédure pénale.

items.title: Finance Ministry rejects claim it withheld ABFA data from PIAC
items.description: The Ministry of Finance has rejected claim that it withheld information on the utilisation of the Annual Budget Funding Amount (ABFA) from the Public Interest and Accountability Committee (PIAC). In a statement issued on Friday, October 23, 2026, the Ministry said it had provided PIAC with petroleum receipts and distribution data and explained the arrangements governing the use of ABFA resources, including funds ring-fenced for the Accra–Kumasi Expressway. The clarification follows a PIAC statement dated October 21 concerning the exclusion of ABFA utilisation data from its 2026 Semi-Annual Report. “The exclusion of ABFA utilisation data from PIAC’s report should therefore not be presented as evidence that the Ministry withheld information,” the Ministry stated. According to the Ministry, officials participated in PIAC’s virtual validation workshop and held in-person meetings with the Committee to explain petroleum revenue receipts, distribution and the arrangements for ABFA utilisation. On the Accra–Kumasi Expressway, the Ministry cited paragraph 572 of the 2026 Mid-Year Fiscal Policy Review, which states that all funds allocated to the project, including the total ABFA realised in 2026, have been ring-fenced. The funds will be used for construction when the contract is awarded. The Ministry said the decision follows PIAC’s recommendation to stop spreading petroleum revenues thinly across numerous projects with limited economic impact. It explained that concentrating the resources on the expressway is intended to deliver a major infrastructure investment with clear national benefits and value for money. The Ministry also rejected suggestions that District Assemblies had been deprived of their share of ABFA resources. It said the five per cent share due to the District Assemblies Common Fund is being paid from the Consolidated Fund, an arrangement it had explained to PIAC. “Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies have therefore not been shortchanged by the decision to ring-fence ABFA resources for the expressway,” the statement said. The Ministry reaffirmed its commitment to providing PIAC with the information required to discharge its mandate and to accounting publicly for petroleum revenues. It added that relevant details would continue to be published in the Annual Report on Petroleum Funds, Petroleum Reconciliation Reports, Budget Statements and other fiscal reports.

items.title: Loi de finances 2027 | Faible appui à la relance économique
items.description: Tout en saluant la proposition incluse dans le projet de loi de finances pour 2027, qui prévoit la création de nouvelles lignes de financement destinées à soutenir les startups et les petites entreprises, Yassine Gouiaa, président de l’Organisation nationale des entrepreneurs, a toutefois estimé que cette mesure demeure insuffisante. Lors de son intervention jeudi 22 octobre 2022, sur Diwan FM , M. Gouiaa a exprimé son étonnement face à l’absence, dans ce projet de loi, de mesures visant à soutenir les entreprises existant depuis plus de cinq ou dix ans. Il a par ailleurs estimé que le montant alloué à la relance économique, soit environ 230 millions de dinars, incluant une enveloppe de 35 millions de dinars dédiée aux seules sociétés communautaires qui peinent à exister, est dérisoire et insuffisant, surtout compte tenu de la crise actuelle et du renchérissement du coût de l’énergie ; il a, à cet égard, appelé à sa révision. Alors que ce texte affiche l'ambition d'atteindre un taux de croissance de 3,1 % pour l'année 2027. «Des lignes de financement avaient été approuvées dans le cadre de précédentes lois de finances, mais, à ce jour, les textes réglementaires nécessaires à leur mise en œuvre n'ont toujours pas été publiés» , a-t-il relevé. items.title: State counsel cross-examines prosecution witnesses in security breach case against Imaan, Hadi
items.description: ISLAMABAD: A state-appointed counsel on Friday cross-examined all prosecution witnesses in a security breach case against lawyers Imaan Zainab Hazir-Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha. Imaan and her husband, Hadi, are facing a jail trial in a 2024 case pertaining to the alleged disruption of an international cricket team’s security route and incitement to public unrest. The couple, accused of removing barriers from the route, was indicted on Oct 7. Anti-terrorism court Judge Tahir Abbas Sipra presided over the hearing held inside Adiala jail on Friday, during which state counsel Atif Mehmood cross-examined a prosecution witness. On Saturday, the court will provide Imaan and Hadi with questionnaires under Section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) to record their statements. In a hearing on Thursday, the court appointed Mehmood as the state counsel to cross-examine the prosecution witnesses, replacing Taimoor Janjua, who was dismissed over his past conduct. The court had ruled to appoint the state attorney after the defence counsel failed to cross-examine the prosecution witnesses. During the last hearing, Imaan informed the court that she and Hadi did not need a state counsel as they already had their own lawyers. Hadi explained that their lawyers were frequently occupied with other cases at the Islamabad High Court (IHC), while the trial court had scheduled daily hearings at Adiala, making it difficult for them to attend every proceeding. The court had directed the prosecution witnesses to appear again on Friday, affirming that the cross-examination would proceed without further delay. Imaan and Hadi’s rearrest The lawyer couple has been in jail since their arrest on Jan 23 in a case registered against them for protesting outside the IHC and allegedly manhandling the IHC Bar Association president. The arrest prompted criticism by rights bodies, politicians and journalists, who stressed the couple’s right to a fair trial. Just a day later, a sessions court sentenced them to 17 years on multiple charges under the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (Peca) in the controversial social media posts case. The convictions were widely condemned by lawyers and United Nations (UN) experts . On Sept 17, following months of litigation before the courts , the Supreme Court suspended their sentences in the case. The SC ordered their release pending the Islamabad High Court’s final verdict on their appeals against the trial court’s decision. However, the reprieve was short-lived as hours later, Islamabad police arrested the couple again in connection with another case and produced them before an ATC, which sent them to jail on judicial remand. The fresh case in which the two were arrested was registered at the federal capital’s Kohsar police station on March 22 last year on the complaint of City Magistrate Ghulam Murtaza Chandio. Imaan and Hadi were accused of chanting anti-government slogans and blocking roads and were nominated by name in the FIR. However, at the time of registration of the case, no section of the Anti-Terrorism Act (ATA) had been added. The FIR included sections 188 (disobedience of an order lawfully promulgated by a public servant), 341 (wrongful restraint), 506 (punishment for criminal intimidation), 353 (assault or use of criminal force to deter a public servant from discharging their official duty) and 186 (obstructing a public servant in the performance of official duties).

items.title: Netanyahu orders West Bank closure as attack wounds Israelis before election
items.description: Palestinian militants wounded five Israelis in an attack on Friday before being killed in a shootout with soldiers, leading Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to order a lockdown in the occupied West Bank days before Israeli elections. Netanyahu, facing a tight race for a new term in Tuesday’s vote, said that Israeli troops prevented what could have been a major attack, with the two assailants allegedly carrying a large quantity of ammunition in their vehicle. Militant group Hamas, without claiming responsibility, praised the attack as a “heroic operation” and called for more. A Hebron-based AFP photographer who was en route to another assignment witnessed the gun battle break out at the Farsh al-Hawa checkpoint near the Palestinian city, and saw two Palestinian men armed with a handgun and an automatic rifle exchanging fire with Israeli forces. Israeli forces eventually shot and killed the attackers, with the AFP journalist seeing their lifeless bodies on the ground next to a petrol station as troops patrolled all around. The Israeli military said soldiers had rushed to the Judea Junction area after the early-morning shooting and “eliminated two terrorists”. The attack wounded five people, two of whom were in critical condition, said Magen David Adom, Israel’s emergency medical rescue service. The service said all five were Israelis in their 20s, including one man in “very serious condition” with gunshot wounds. With the clock counting down to election day, Netanyahu called for all Likud party political meetings to be cancelled Friday due to the attack. – ‘Full lockdown’ – “I salute the courage of our soldiers who acted with determination and prevented what could have been a major attack,” Netanyahu said in a statement. “I have instructed the IDF (army) and security forces to impose an immediate cordon on the city of Hebron and to prepare for a full lockdown of all of Judea and Samaria starting today,” Netanyahu said, using the biblical name for the Israeli-occupied West Bank. He added that troops were “carrying out stepped-up operations to thwart terrorist activities and are conducting large-scale waves of arrests”. The military said it had “launched offensive counter-terrorism operations in the Hebron area”, adding that troops were raiding homes of the suspects and others. Far-right Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called for a fresh military offensive “exactly like in Gaza” in the West Bank. “There is no other option but a comprehensive military campaign in Judea and Samaria to dismantle the Palestinian Authority, collect weapons and eliminate terrorists. Exactly like in Gaza and Lebanon,” said Smotrich, who also holds a position within the defence ministry. “In the next government this will be one of the first measures that we must demand and apply.” He later said he had “ordered the immediate demolition of a wide row of illegal Arab structures adjacent to the attack site”. Israeli National Security Minister and far-right firebrand Itamar Ben Gvir, who has been rising in the polls, also called for the Ramallah-based Palestinian Authority to be “dismantled and demilitarised, and its terror infrastructure wiped out completely”. No evidence suggests that the Palestinian Authority, the Palestinian government in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, was connected to Friday’s attack. – Hamas praises attack – Hamas, which is based in Gaza and carried out the October 7, 2023 attack, the deadliest in Israel’s history, hailed the attack and mourned the two dead assailants. The attack was a “natural and legitimate response to the ongoing crimes and brutal attacks against our people”, Hamas, the rival of the Palestinian Authority’s ruling Fatah faction, said in a statement. It called on supporters to “mobilise fully and turn the land into a fire beneath the feet of the invaders”, urging anyone with weapons to carry out more attacks. Netanyahu in his statement vowed to “pursue Hamas terrorists” everywhere, adding: “You have no place to hide.” Gadi Eisenkot, the former army chief who is Netanyahu’s top rival in the election, praised the response by troops. “Like all Israelis, I pray for the complete and quick recovery of the injured,” he said. The incident comes as tensions soar in the West Bank, including over attacks by extremist Israeli settlers against Palestinian olive harvesters, and days ahead of Israeli elections. According to an AFP tally based on data from the Palestinian health ministry, Israeli forces or settlers have killed 1,113 Palestinians in the territory since the start of the Gaza war in October 2023. Israeli figures show at least 49 Israelis, including civilians and security personnel, have been killed in Palestinian attacks or during Israeli military operations during the same period. items.title: Tinubu, APC owe Nigerians answers on N10bn Ebola fund — Atiku campaign spokesman
items.description: By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA – President Bola Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress, APC, have been challenged to explain the whereabouts of the ₦10 billion the Presidency announced for Ebola preparedness in June, after the ruling party reportedly claimed the fund remained untouched despite a confirmed case in Abuja. Phrank Shaibu, Director of Strategic Communication, ADC Presidential Campaign Council, said the claim raised serious questions about the Tinubu administration’s preparedness, accusing the APC of trading political insults instead of accounting for the emergency fund. In a statement on Friday, Shaibu said the APC’s response to former Vice President Atiku Abubakar’s demand for accountability had focused on the similarity between Tinubu’s name and Ebola rather than the money and the government’s response to the outbreak. “These aren’t just rhyming words; the effect of Bola’s policies is as deadly as the dreaded Ebola,” Shaibu said. The statement recalled that the Presidency announced on June 9 that Tinubu had ordered the immediate release of ₦10 billion for Ebola emergency preparedness, questioning why the APC would now describe the money as untouched. “Was the money released or was it not? If it was released, where is it held, who controls it, and why has it not been used for the preparedness President Tinubu announced in June?” Shaibu asked. He demanded the release documents, account records and Ebola Task Force expenditure reports, insisting that the controversy could not be settled through attacks on Atiku. Shaibu also questioned the government’s response timeline, citing the World Health Organisation’s account that the patient developed symptoms on October 7, sought treatment at a private facility on October 11, and received laboratory confirmation on October 20. “The APC claims surveillance ‘tipped off’ the government. Then publish the timeline. Name the agency that raised the alert, give the date and explain the action taken,” he said. He asked when Ebola was first suspected, when public health authorities were alerted, when testing was ordered and when contact tracing began. On the 44 identified contacts, Shaibu said their safety, rather than political point-scoring, should be the priority. “44 identified contacts are people whose health must be protected. They are not a trophy for an APC press release,” he said. He said health workers treating the patient and tracing contacts deserved adequate protection, equipment and resources, stressing that scrutiny of the government’s preparedness should not be confused with an attack on those working to contain the outbreak. Shaibu also urged the Tinubu administration to publish any proposed restrictions on campaigning or voting arising from the health emergency, together with their medical justification and the advice of relevant health authorities. “Public health guidance must protect people. It must never become a political tool,” he said. He maintained that the Presidency and the APC must resolve the controversy through documentary evidence, explain the response timeline and demonstrate that the necessary measures were in place to protect Nigerians. “President Tinubu and the APC owe the country answers, not ‘Bola-Ebola’ tales,” Shaibu said. The post Tinubu, APC owe Nigerians answers on N10bn Ebola fund — Atiku campaign spokesman appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Pope Leo to miss Assisi gathering – Vatican
items.description: Pope Leo XIV will not attend a peace gathering at Assisi next week on doctors’ advice as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said Friday. “To support recovery following last Tuesday’s thoracic surgery, and following the doctors’ advice, Pope Leo XIV will not be able to attend the ‘Disarmed and Disarming Peace’ meeting in Assisi on October 27th,” wrote the Vatican in a note. The Assisi meeting, on the 40th anniversary of the World Day of Prayer for Peace, will go ahead with Leo sending a message to the event, the Vatican said. The doctors, Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritora, wrote in a separate note published by the Vatican that although a chest X-ray of the pope showed “excellent progress of the post-operative recovery”, they advised caution for the Assisi trip. “Considering the short time since the surgery, the attending doctors thought it prudent, as a precaution, to advise against the scheduled helicopter trip on October 27,” they said. Leo, 71, was discharged on Saturday from Rome’s Gemelli hospital five days after surgery to remove the lower part of his right lung where they had detected a cancerous nodule. His doctors said Wednesday that no further therapy was required following the successful operation, with the cancer having been found to be “localised”. On Sunday, the leader of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics said he would resume his duties “gradually”. Doctors have said there is no medical reason that the pope cannot go ahead with a long-planned visit to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he lived for two decades, on November 6-17. Leo last visited Assisi — which celebrates this year the 800th anniversary of St Francis’ death — in August for an event with thousands of young people from across Europe. The prayer event, held from October Sunday to Tuesday, will bring together 384 representatives of religions, cultures and institutions from 53 countries, according to the Vatican. The event was started under Pope John Paul II. The post Pope Leo to miss Assisi gathering – Vatican appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Fusillade à Paris : un mort, quatre blessés et un suspect interpellé
items.description: Une fusillade survenue vendredi matin à Trappes et à La Verrière, dans les Yvelines, a fait au moins un mort et quatre blessés. Le suspect, un homme de 39 ans selon une source policière citée par Paris Match, a été interpellé à Coignières. Les circonstances de cette attaque restent à préciser. Une fusillade a fait au moins un mort et quatre blessés vendredi 23 octobre dans les communes de Trappes et de La Verrière, dans les Yvelines, en France. Selon une source policière citée par l’AFP, les faits se sont produits aux alentours de 10h30, heure française. Le suspect a été rapidement interpellé par les forces de l’ordre à Coignières, a indiqué cette même source. Au moment des premières informations, les secours étaient toujours mobilisés et le bilan n’était pas encore stabilisé, selon la préfecture des Yvelines. D’après les informations de Paris Match, qui cite une source policière, le suspect serait un homme âgé de 39 ans. Il aurait utilisé une arme présentée comme un pistolet-mitrailleur de type STEN, datant de la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Toujours selon cette source, les victimes auraient été visées au hasard. Ces premiers éléments restent à confirmer dans le cadre des investigations. Les circonstances précises des tirs, le profil des victimes et les motivations éventuelles du suspect n’étaient pas établis au moment de la publication des premières informations. Les autorités doivent désormais préciser le déroulement des faits et les éléments ayant conduit à l’interpellation du suspect. Le bilan définitif ainsi que les conclusions de l’enquête restent attendus. The post Fusillade à Paris : un mort, quatre blessés et un suspect interpellé appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .
